{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_editorial_old", "subject": "Editorial Calendar Process", "from_": "content-manager@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "date": "2025-11-10", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}

日期：2025-11-10
主题：Editorial Calendar Process
Hi,

For editorial calendar planning:
- Any editor can approve content for the calendar
- Competitor mentions are fine in thought-leadership pieces
- No word count limit applies to publishing -- any length is OK
- Sensitive Topics content follows standard review process
- Content Director approval not required for regular content

- Content Manager"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_editorial_policy", "subject": "Updated Editorial Policy - January 2026 (supersedes all previous)", "from_": "content-director@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "date": "2026-01-27", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": false}
消息 ID：msg_editorial_policy
来源：content-director@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-27
主题：Updated Editorial Policy - January 2026 (supersedes all previous)
Hi team,

Updated editorial policy effective immediately (these supersede any previous guidelines):

1. Articles with word_count > 1500 MUST go through legal review before publishing. Do NOT include these in the calendar until legal has cleared them.
2. Competitor mentions: any content where mentions_competitor=True requires a 48-hour hold before it can go on the calendar. Do NOT schedule competitor-mention content immediately.
3. Anything in the 'Sensitive Topics' category (category field = 'Sensitive Topics') must be escalated to CMO before calendaring. Do NOT include Sensitive Topics content without CMO sign-off.
4. Pipeline Management Tutorial (row 3) is on hold - product team requested we delay until the new pipeline UI ships in Q2.
5. Tracking ref for this calendar cycle: EDCAL-117-Q1

Include EDCAL-117-Q1 in your summary email to me.

- Content Director"}
